title: rustpix: High-performance Rust library for pixel-detector (Timepix3) data processing
description: rustpix is a high-performance Rust library with first-class Python bindings (via PyO3) for pixel-detector data processing in neutron imaging. It processes Timepix3 (TPX3) event data at 96M+ hits/sec, provides multiple clustering algorithms (ABS, DBSCAN, Graph, Grid) and centroid extraction, and is designed to extend to TPX4 and other detector types.
